description: This file defines an interface 'DatatableReadService' for data access operations related to data tables within the Fineract project, including retrieving datatable names, querying data, and counting entries.

classes.name: DatatableReadService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading data tables, including retrieval, querying, counting, and metadata functions.

methods.name: retrieveDatatableNames
methods.description: Returns a list of data table names associated with the specified application table.

methods.name: retrieveDatatable
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific datatable.

methods.name: queryDataTable
methods.description: Executes a query against a datatable based on column name and value, returning matching JSON objects.

methods.name: queryDataTableAdvanced
methods.description: Performs an advanced paged query on a datatable with additional filtering options.

methods.name: buildDataQueryEmbedded
methods.description: Constructs a data query dynamically, embedding SQL components based on parameters and locale.

methods.name: retrieveDataTableGenericResultSet
methods.description: Retrieves a generic result set for a datatable with optional ordering and filtering by ID.

methods.name: countDatatableEntries
methods.description: Counts the number of entries in a specified datatable, optionally filtered by foreign key.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Extracts the table name from a URL.

methods.name: getDataTableName
methods.description: Extracts the data table name from a URL.
